description:
Town Council Meeting Overview

Join us for our regular Town Council Meeting, where local leaders come together to discuss community initiatives, town projects, and important decisions that impact our residents. This meeting is an opportunity for citizens to stay informed, share input, and engage with town representatives as we work to enhance the quality of life in our community.

Typical topics covered include:

Updates on town projects and infrastructure
Budget and financial reports
Community events and announcements
Public safety and ordinances
Open forum for public comments
We invite all residents to attend and participate—your voice shapes our town's future!

Visit Historic Downtown
Elloree:
Street Vendors

Church Flea Markets
Don’t miss the Yard Sales throughout the Town of

Elloree!

To apply as a vendor, visit www.elloreesc.com for

Applications and fees must be received by Friday,
October 2, 2026 to participate in this event. No late

Time: 6:00 PM–8:00 PM
Location: Elloree First Baptist Church Fellowship Hall
6208 Old Number Six Highway
Elloree, SC 29047

Description:
Join Dominion Energy for the Neighborhood Energy Efficiency Program Kickoff. Learn about free energy-saving home improvements available to eligible residential electric customers.

A light meal will be served, and attendees will have a chance to win several $25 gift cards. You must be present to win. No identification is required. Bringing a face covering is optional.

For more information, call 1-855-342-8548.

Click to view more: https://elloreesc.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/NEEP_260714_093252.pdf
